sloka: गते पुरोहिते रामः स्नातो नियतमानसः ।सह पत्न्या विशालाक्ष्या नारायणमुपागमत् ॥२-६-१॥
transliteration: gate purohite rāmaḥ snāto niyatamānasaḥ ।saha patnyā viśālākṣyā nārāyaṇamupāgamat ॥2-6-1॥

translations.english: With the family priest (Vasistha) gone, Rama had his bath, and with his mind under control came to Lord Narayana along with his largeeyed consort, Sita. (with an intention to worship him)
